name: Do I need to remove my old kitchen floor before installing a new one?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to remove my old kitchen floor before installing a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes, removing the old kitchen floor is recommended for the best results. This ensures a stable and level subfloor, which is crucial for proper installation and longevity of your new flooring. Sometimes, a new floor can be installed over an existing one if the existing floor is flat, structurally sound, and compatible with the new material, but this is less common for kitchens.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing the old kitchen floor is usually recommended to ensure a stable and level subfloor for proper installation and longevity of the new flooring.
